info.title: codemap
info.description: Maps C# solutions (and TypeScript / JavaScript with Node.js, Python with Python 3.9+) into a relationship graph (JSON, DGML, GraphML, Cypher) and an interactive 3D map.

commands.name: export
commands.description: convert an existing graph to other formats

options.name: --output
options.description: output directory (default: ./codemap-out)

options.name: --format
options.description:
comma separated: json, html, md, dgml, graphml, cypher, all
(default: json,html,md)

options.name: --name
options.description: base name of the output files (default: solution/project/package name)

options.name: --external
options.description: include framework / NuGet types the code depends on

options.name: --no-tests
options.description: skip test projects

options.name: --generated
options.description: include generated code (*.g.cs, *.Designer.cs, <auto-generated>)

options.name: --types-only
options.description:
drop member nodes, keep their relationships rolled up to types
(much smaller output for very large solutions)

options.name: --lang
options.description: only these languages: csharp, typescript, python (default: all that are found)

options.name: --plugins
options.description: also look for language plugins in <dir>

options.name: --checks
options.description:
also check the code inside function bodies (swallowed exceptions, sync over async,
floating promises, unreachable code, selected compiler warnings); in the .md report

options.name: --no-git
options.description: do not read git history (churn / hotspots)

options.name: --git-since
options.description: limit git history, e.g. "1 year ago"

options.name: --indent
options.description: pretty-print JSON

options.name: --viewer
options.description: use a custom viewer template instead of the embedded one

options.name: --open
options.description:
open the HTML map when done
MCP options (codemap mcp):

options.name: --root
options.description: folder that relative paths start from (default: the client's root, else the current one)

options.name: --no-watch
options.description: do not watch the sources (answers then never say the analysis is stale)

options.name: --max-output
options.description: the most characters of one tool answer (default 30000; longer lists are cut)

options.name: --no-checks
options.description: do not check function bodies (on by default for agents)

options.name: --browser
options.description:
Chrome, Edge or Chromium for render_map (default: CODEMAP_BROWSER, else the installed one)
(--lang, --plugins, --no-git, --git-since, --no-tests, --generated, --external work as for analysis)
App options (codemap / codemap ui):

options.name: --port
options.description: preferred port (default 5180; a free one is used if taken)

options.name: --no-open
options.description: do not open the browser

options.name: --watch
options.description: re-analyze automatically when the sources change

options.name: --quiet
options.description: less output

options.name: --help
options.description: show this help

options.name: --version
options.description: show version

commands.name: mcp
commands.description: run as an MCP server (stdio) for AI agents: the map, findings, call flows,

commands.name: ui
commands.description: same, and start analyzing <path> right away
